description:
1. Agent reads the novel at /workspace/projects/凌云传/novels/凌云传.txt and identifies: scenes (courtyard, woodshed night), characters (云霄, 李傲, 系统), the flashback (father's memory), the system announcement, and the psychological monologue.
2. Agent generates a complete header block with all required fields including 作品名/题材/类型/简略梗概/主要角色/受众/情绪承诺 AND the proprietary '本集一句话' following the template '主角为了【目标】在【规则/限制】下，被【对手/压力】逼到【困境】，最后【变化】并引出【续看问题】'.
3. Agent structures scenes using the proprietary scene header format '1-1 场景名 日外/日内/夜外/夜内' (the time-of-day code is a critical trap).
4. Agent uses ▲ (triangle symbol) to prefix ALL shot descriptions with proper framing terms (近景/全景/中景/特写).
5. Agent converts the psychological monologue '他心想' into the proprietary OS format: character name on one line, 'OS' on the next line, then the monologue text.
6. Agent wraps the father flashback with 【闪回】...【闪出】 markers.
7. Agent converts the system announcement into '系统：' dialogue format.
8. Agent includes 音效:/BGM:/特效: markers for action moments.
9. Agent saves the file as '《凌云传》剧本.txt' (with 《》 brackets) in the SAME directory as the source novel: /workspace/projects/凌云传/novels/《凌云传》剧本.txt.
